hyperparameters.name: gradient ascent steps for computing samples µ(x)

methods.name: gradient ascent
methods.description: used to ﬁnd x⋆on the learned conservative model, ˆfθ

methods.name: conservative objective model
methods.description: Modeled as a neural network with two hidden layers of size 2048 each and leaky ReLU activations

methods.name: Adam optimizer
methods.description: Used to train the conservative objective model with a learning rate of 10−3

methods.name: gradient-ascent optimizer
methods.description: Used during optimization with a learning rate of 0.05 for continuous tasks and 2.0 for discrete tasks

methods.name: conservative training
methods.description: Training ˆfθ by performing gradient descent on θ with respect to the objective in Equation 7 with a learning rate η to lower-bound the true function.

methods.name: neural tangent kernel (NTK)
methods.description: Model of neural nets where the kernel of the function ˆf(x) is defined as Gf(xi,xj) := ∇θˆfθ(xi)T∇θˆfθ(xj).
